(1) Happy 200: pro-photos-uploader renders, ZERO pageerrors (no more 'loadState is not defined'), 2 seeded thumbnails visible, pro-photos-file ENABLED, label 'Add photos'. (2) 401 injected via page.route: pro-photos-load-error visible with exact copy "Couldn't load your gallery — please refresh before uploading so we don't overwrite it.", pro-photos-file disabled=true, label styled cursor-not-allowed/bg-slate-200, real-user path fully blocked (label.click() times out, no filechooser event, ZERO PATCH requests). action_items: LOW: eslint react/no-unescaped-entities errors at ProPhotosUploader.jsx:91 (two raw apostrophes in the load-error copy). Renders fine but `yarn eslint` fails on this file — escape with ' / ’.

LOW (defense-in-depth, optional): the overwrite guard is client-side only (disabled attribute). Automation that bypasses the disabled input (Playwright set_input_files) still triggers PATCH /boat-pros/photos with a shorter array, replacing the gallery. Real users cannot do this (label click and filechooser are blocked), so no user-facing bug — but the server has no guard against a shrinking photos array. Consider an explicit intent flag or optimistic-concurrency check if this matters.
critical_code_review_comments: ProPhotosUploader.jsx now correct: loadState declared (line 20), useEffect maps 404 -> ready+empty and other errors -> error without clearing photos, and the disabled expression `photos.length >= 6 || busy || loadState !== 'ready'` covers loading and error states.
Profile.jsx still has no error boundary — any child throw would again blank the whole authenticated /profile route. Worth adding as a general safety net.

rca_of_the_issue: iter48's ReferenceError was caused by a half-applied edit (JSX referenced loadState with no useState). The iter49 patch adds the declaration and the useEffect state transitions; component now mounts cleanly and all three load states behave as specified.
